::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [1853?]  
**Manuscript:** MS  Harry Ransom Humanities Research Center, University of Texas, Austin
:::

Miss Yonge requests Messrs Forbes and Marshall to send for

Mrs E Barrett Browning’s [poems](other_books/otherbook_21.qmd)
The last [Edinburgh review](organizations/other_132.qmd)
[Rollo and his race](other_books/otherbook_177.qmd)
[The Provocations of Mde Palissy](other_books/otherbook_111.qmd)

The books at present at Otterbourn shall be returned either on Thursday or the first day after it that Joyce the carrier goes to Southampton
